pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)ㄴ/는 한편 (On One Hand... On the Other Hand)
meaningEn: Expressing that while one action or situation is occurring, another complementary or contrasting action happens concurrently ('on one hand... on the other hand / while at the same time').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa di saat satu tindakan atau situasi terjadi, tindakan lain yang melengkapi atau berlawanan terjadi secara bersamaan ('di satu sisi... di sisi lain / sekaligus').

notesEn.formation: Verb Present: ~는 한편 / Verb Past: ~(으)ㄴ 한편. Adj: ~(으)ㄴ 한편. Noun: Noun인 한편.
notesEn.usage: Used in formal reports, journalism, and academic essays to present dual aspects of a situation.
notesEn.nuance: Highlights simultaneity and dual perspectives in structured discourse.

notesId.formation: Kata Kerja Hadir: ~는 한편 / Kata Kerja Lampau: ~(으)ㄴ 한편. Kata Sifat: ~(으)ㄴ 한편. Kata Benda: Kata Benda인 한편.
notesId.usage: Digunakan dalam laporan formal, jurnalistik, dan esai akademis untuk menyajikan dua aspek situasi.
notesId.nuance: Menyoroti keserentakan dan sudut pandang ganda dalam wacana terstruktur.

examples.hangul: 정부는 경제를 활성화하는 한편 물가 안정에도 힘쓰고 있다.
examples.romaja: jeong-bu-neun gyeong-je-reul hwal-seong-hwa-ha-neun han-pyeon mul-ga an-jeong-e-do him-sseu-go it-da.
examples.meaningEn: The government is revitalizing the economy on one hand, while working to stabilize prices on the other.
examples.meaningId: Pemerintah menggairahkan perekonomian di satu sisi, sekaligus mengupayakan stabilisasi harga di sisi lain.

examples.hangul: 그는 대학원에서 공부하는 한편 연구소에서 일하고 있습니다.
examples.romaja: geu-neun dae-hak-won-e-seo gong-bu-ha-neun han-pyeon yeon-gu-so-e-seo il-ha-go it-seum-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: He is studying in graduate school while simultaneously working at a research institute.
examples.meaningId: Dia belajar di pascasarjana di satu sisi, sekaligus bekerja di lembaga penelitian.

examples.hangul: 신제품의 장점을 홍보하는 한편 단점도 보완해야 합니다.
examples.romaja: sin-je-pum-ui jang-jeom-eul hong-bo-ha-neun han-pyeon dan-jeom-do bo-wan-hae-ya ham-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: While promoting the advantages of the new product, we must also complement its shortcomings.
examples.meaningId: Di samping mempromosikan keunggulan produk baru, kita juga harus menutupi kekurangannya.

quiz.question: Which connector presents dual simultaneous actions or perspectives ('on one hand... on the other')?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄴ/는 한편 balances two simultaneous or contrasting actions/perspectives.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄴ/는 한편 menyeimbangkan dua tindakan/perspektif yang serentak atau berlawanan.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceHangul: 정부는 경제를 활성화하___ 물가 안정에도 힘쓰고 있다.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert connector meaning 'on one hand / simultaneously'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'The government is revitalizing the economy on one hand, while working to stabilize prices on the other.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Pemerintah menggairahkan perekonomian di satu sisi, sekaligus mengupayakan stabilisasi harga di sisi lain.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 정부는 경제를 활성화하는 한편 물가 안정에도 힘쓰고 있다
constructionQuiz.answerReading: jeong-bu-neun gyeong-je-reul hwal-seong-hwa-ha-neun han-pyeon mul-ga an-jeong-e-do him-sseu-go it-da

constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan pemerintah (정부는) + menggairahkan ekonomi (경제를 활성화하) + di satu sisi (는 한편) + stabilitas harga juga (물가 안정에도) + mengupayakan (힘쓰고 있다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다 (There Is No Room/Scope For)
meaningEn: Stating definitively that there is no possibility, doubt, or room for debate regarding a matter ('no room for / no scope to').
meaningId: Menyatakan secara pasti bahwa tidak ada kemungkinan, keraguan, atau ruang untuk perdebatan mengenai suatu hal ('tidak ada ruang untuk / tidak ada celah').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 여지가 없다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 여지가 없다.
notesEn.usage: Commonly used in formal arguments, legal judgments, and research conclusions.
notesEn.nuance: 여지 (餘地) means 'remaining space/margin'; this pattern asserts total conclusive clarity.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 여지가 없다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 여지가 없다.
notesId.usage: Sangat umum dalam argumen formal, putusan hukum, dan kesimpulan penelitian.
notesId.nuance: 여지 (餘地) berarti 'sisa ruang/celah'; pola ini menegaskan kejelasan konklusif total.

examples.meaningEn: There is no room for doubt regarding this result.
examples.meaningId: Hasil ini tidak memiliki ruang untuk diragukan lagi.

examples.meaningEn: It is an obvious mistake with no room for excuses.
examples.meaningId: Ini adalah kesalahan nyata yang tidak ada celah untuk dimaafkan/alasan.

examples.meaningEn: The agenda was rejected without even room for reconsideration.
examples.meaningId: Agenda tersebut ditolak tanpa ada ruang untuk dipertimbangkan kembali.

quiz.question: What does '~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다' mean in formal discourse?
options: There is no room or scope for something
There is a high chance of failure
It is done merely out of duty
It is easy to fall into a trap
quiz.explanationEn: 여지 means 'margin/room', so ~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다 indicates no room or scope for doubt/excuses.
quiz.explanationId: 여지 berarti 'ruang/celah', sehingga ~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다 menunjukkan tidak ada ruang untuk keraguan/alasan.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: There is no room for doubt regarding this result. -> 이 결과는 의심할 ___가 없습니다.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'There is no room for doubt regarding this result.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Hasil ini tidak memiliki ruang untuk diragukan lagi.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use this result (이 결과는) + doubt modifier (의심할) + room (여지가) + doesn't exist (없습니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan hasil ini (이 결과는) + meragukan (의심할) + ruang (여지가) + tidak ada (없습니다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~기/게 마련이다 vs ~법이다 (Natural Law & Principle Synthesis)
meaningEn: Expressing natural inevitability based on universal laws or fundamental principles.
meaningId: Mengekspresikan kepastian alami berdasarkan hukum alam universal atau prinsip dasar.

notesEn.formation: Verb Stem + ~기 마련이다 / Verb Stem + ~는 법이다.
notesEn.usage: Both state natural outcomes, but ~는 법이다 sounds slightly more like an established maxim or rule of nature.
notesEn.nuance: ~기 마련이다 = naturally bound to happen; ~는 법이다 = universally ordained principle.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~기 마련이다 / Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~는 법이다.
notesId.usage: Keduanya menyatakan hasil yang alami, namun ~는 법이다 terdengar seperti pepatah atau hukum alam yang baku.
notesId.nuance: ~기 마련이다 = secara alami pasti terjadi; ~는 법이다 = prinsip universal yang ditetapkan.

examples.meaningEn: Pleasure naturally comes after hardship (It is a rule of nature).
examples.meaningId: Kesenangan secara alami datang setelah kesusahan (Hukum alam).

examples.meaningEn: Wounds naturally heal as time passes.
examples.meaningId: Luka secara alami akan sembuh seiring berjalannya waktu.

examples.meaningEn: Justice inevitably prevails in the end.
examples.meaningId: Keadilan pada akhirnya pasti akan menang.

quiz.question: Which proverb-like grammar pattern asserts a universal rule of nature ('is bound to / law of nature')?
quiz.explanationEn: ~는 법이다 asserts that a situation follows a universal rule or natural law.
quiz.explanationId: ~는 법이다 menegaskan bahwa suatu situasi mengikuti aturan universal atau hukum alam.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Justice inevitably prevails in the end. -> 정의는 결국 승리하___.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert pattern for universal law of nature.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan pola untuk hukum alam universal.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Justice inevitably prevails in the end.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Keadilan pada akhirnya pasti akan menang.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use justice (정의는) + ultimately (결국) + win (승리하) + law of nature (는 법이다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan keadilan (정의는) + pada akhirnya (결국) + menang (승리하) + hukum alam (는 법이다).

meaningEn: Expressing deep regret over an action that should have been taken in the past but was not ('should have done...').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan penyesalan mendalam atas tindakan yang seharusnya dilakukan di masa lalu tetapi tidak dilakukan ('seharusnya...').

notesEn.usage: Essential for reflecting on past mistakes, personal regrets, or analytical post-mortems.
notesEn.nuance: Conveys a strong sense of missed opportunity.

notesId.formation: Bentuk Dasar Lampau Kata Kerja + ~야 했는데.
notesId.usage: Sangat penting untuk merenungkan kesalahan masa lalu, penyesalan pribadi, atau analisis pasca-kejadian.
notesId.nuance: Menyampaikan rasa kehilangan kesempatan yang kuat.

examples.meaningEn: I should have prepared in advance, but I failed to do so.
examples.meaningId: Saya seharusnya bersiap terlebih dahulu, tetapi saya tidak melakukannya.

examples.hangul: 그때 그 기회를 잡았어야 했는데 아쉽네요.
examples.romaja: geu-ttae geu gi-hoe-reul jab-as-seo-ya hwaen-de a-swip-ne-yo.
examples.meaningEn: I should have seized that opportunity back then; it's regrettable.
examples.meaningId: Saya seharusnya mengambil kesempatan itu saat itu; sangat disayangkan.

examples.hangul: 조금 더 신중하게 결정했어야 했는데 후회됩니다.
examples.romaja: jo-geum deo sin-jung-ha-ge gyeol-jeong-haes-seo-ya hwaen-de hu-hoe-doe-muni-da.
examples.meaningEn: I should have decided a bit more carefully; I regret it.
examples.meaningId: Saya seharusnya memutuskan dengan sedikit lebih hati-hati; saya menyesalinya.

quiz.question: Which grammar pattern expresses retrospective regret for a missed past obligation/action?
quiz.explanationEn: ~았/었어야 했는데 expresses regret over an action that should have happened in the past.
quiz.explanationId: ~았/었어야 했는데 mengekspresikan penyesalan atas tindakan yang seharusnya terjadi di masa lalu.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I should have prepared in advance... -> 미리 준비했___ 그러지 못했습니다.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I should have prepared in advance, but I couldn't.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya seharusnya bersiap terlebih dahulu, tetapi saya tidak bisa.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use in advance (미리) + prepare should have (준비했어야 했는데) + so couldn't (그러지 못했습니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan terlebih dahulu (미리) + seharusnya bersiap (준비했어야 했는데) + begitu tidak bisa (그러지 못했습니다).

meaningEn: Synthesizing ultimate humble dedication or single-focus limitation in advanced Korean.
meaningId: Mensintesis pengabdian rendah hati atau batasan fokus tunggal dalam bahasa Korea tingkat lanjut.

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 따름이다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 따름이다.
notesEn.usage: Final capstone pattern representing total formal humility or absolute limitation.
notesEn.nuance: Expresses 'I am merely / I can only do X and nothing more'.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 따름이다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 따름이다.
notesId.usage: Pola penutup akhir yang mewakili kerendahan hati formal total atau batasan mutlak.
notesId.nuance: Mengekspresikan 'Saya hanya sekadar / Saya hanya bisa melakukan X dan tidak ada lagi'.

examples.meaningEn: I merely attribute this glory to everyone.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya sekadar mempersembahkan kehormatan ini kepada semua orang.

examples.meaningEn: I am merely doing my best silently.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya sekadar melakukan yang terbaik secara diam-diam.

examples.meaningEn: I am merely conveying my words of deep gratitude.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya sekadar menyampaikan rasa terima kasih saya yang mendalam.

quiz.question: Which phrase captures 'I am merely doing my best silently'?
options: 묵묵히 최선을 다할 락 말락 합니다
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 expresses humble limitation ('merely doing X').
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 mengekspresikan batasan rendah hati ('hanya sekadar melakukan X').

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I am merely doing my best silently. -> 묵묵히 최선을 다할 ___입니다.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert bound noun of humble limitation.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat untuk batasan rendah hati.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I am merely doing my best silently.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya hanya sekadar melakukan yang terbaik secara diam-diam.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use silently (묵묵히) + best do modifier (최선을 다할) + merely (따름입니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan secara diam-diam (묵묵히) + melakukan yang terbaik (최선을 다할) + sekadar (따름입니다).
